shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rectangular upright slab
horizontal register or band dividing the composition
wing/feather-like patterning rendered as repeated parallel strokes
a disc or round object within the field
repeated row of similar motifs along the top
justification: Both are low-relief upright slabs organised in horizontal registers, with a band of repeated motifs across the top and feather-like parallel-stroke texturing, and both include a small round disc element within the field. But A shows a single large anthropomorphic winged figure with a raised arm, elaborate beard, garments and bucket-like attribute rendered in fine naturalistic detail, whereas B shows a stack of schematic animals (beaked birds, a quadruped, a small crouching figure) with no human protagonist and far cruder, flatter outlines.
